parameters.query:
WITH candidate (item_key, source, title, payload, is_control) AS (
  VALUES (
    NULLIF('{{$json.item_key ? $json.item_key.replace(/'/g, "''") : ""}}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{$json.source ? $json.source.replace(/'/g, "''") : "linkedin"}}', ''),
    NULLIF('{{$json.title ? $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") : ""}}', ''),
    '{{$json.payload_json ? $json.payload_json.replace(/'/g, "''") : "{}"}}'::jsonb,
    {{$json.__playwrightError === true || $json.__playwrightEmpty === true || $json.__noResults === true ? 'true' : 'false'}}
  )
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO assistant_processed_items (item_key, source, title, payload)
  SELECT item_key, source, title, payload
  FROM candidate
  WHERE NOT is_control AND item_key IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (item_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING item_key
)
SELECT
  c.item_key,
  c.source,
  c.title,
  c.payload,
  c.is_control,
  (i.item_key IS NOT NULL) AS inserted
FROM candidate c
LEFT JOIN inserted i ON i.item_key = c.item_key;
